title: [Crash] System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception: Error creating window handle.
author: vansanper
body_snippet:

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you, and in particular for the line you added above the crash report: "after Nvidia drivers update" is the first trigger anyone has given for this crash. It is the third report of the same stack (#174, #183), so we are keeping this issue as the one to work on, because you can answer questions and the others were anonymous; #174 is closed in favour of this one.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Closing — unanswered.

On 25 September we asked for the monitor layout and the scaling in effect when the "Error creating window handle" crash happened, including the note that it followed an Nvidia driver update. There has been no reply.

We have not reproduced that crash here. Seven days have passed, so this is closed as unanswered. It is not a finding that the crash cannot happen. The layout, the scaling, and whether a window was already failing to open, reopen it.
